checks: Five-stage sequence distinguishes revenue from profit/cash.
Attendance capacity limit and censored demand remain explicit.
Revenue, EBITDA and DCF shown as valuation cross-checks, not an invented weighted formula.
No move/sign/trade, target leverage, cash floor, debt limit and salary cap are visible.
Feedback labelled Update as games are observed returns to performance; exogenous scenarios grouped separately.
Removed dark background and accidental printed section/page instructions; final title and labels readable.
No numeric business outcome or code execution result is shown.
